scopes.s1: Controller entry named statically; only suffix 0x5316d7d4..0x5316d7ec was executed in UI probe.
scopes.s2: User focus enums/list/storage, separate from internal AF process IDs. Eligibility, widgets, refresh/notification services substituted where stated in entry.
scopes.s3: Entry-snapshot restore is distinct from build-recipe reset. Synthetic callback/controller/services; no production reset control or physical gesture installed.
scopes.s4: Original TopMenu layout and retained range dialog; absence established only in five normal item arrays. Tab a/b names remain intentionally neutral.
scopes.s5: Stock Fn-specific override and numeric logical-event contracts; physical button identities and result meaning remain unresolved. Legacy probe ADJ aliases CaptureReadyModel, not an ADJ-only class.
scopes.s6: Existing shared-family source bindings; exact GR III profile identity retained. Imported source evidence does not independently replay each symbol on camera.
scopes.s7: Internal processes/patterns and logical begin/end are distinct from menu modes/physical gestures. Pending consumer is prefix-only evidence; no completed acknowledgment or acquisition timing.
scopes.s8: Completed before freeze: current-record point, stable pointer across mode copy and direction registry commit. No input/cadence/owner-generation/bank integration; AF reset and clamp services substituted.
scopes.s9: Current-record+0x130 word setter read statically; ADJ values reached substituted backend in AF-UI-001.
scopes.s10: Configuration serialization/storage only; scan-range storage is not proof of an effective search limiter.
scopes.s11: Original model/storage instructions exercised by external recipe reset. Live-property acceptance/propagation and redraw are substituted.
scopes.s12: Native ADJ metadata/list behavior. Record+0x38 is endpoint policy; availability is at+0x3c/+0x40. No physical key identity.
scopes.s13: Static caller/path provenance only; playback YCC names do not establish live histogram signal origin.
scopes.s14: Native storage/draw dispatch only; no RAW/JPEG stage, channel-name or selected-frame provenance.
scopes.s15: Diagnostic/prologue/dependency-store anchors; initialization does not establish active mode routing.
scopes.s16: Bounded native arithmetic/state and wave lifecycles. Correlation+0x9e is current reliability, not a tunable static threshold. Ring count/readiness is not physical frame freshness.
scopes.s17: Original registry/setter/commit/readback; synchronous queue replacement and final flush/service substitutions as documented. Mode metadata destination+0x6f4 is a different context.
scopes.s18: Tag/provider/source-documented direction boundaries; no per-frame ISO-to-JPEG join or orientation AF bank claimed.
scopes.s19: Static job/config copy boundaries; no decode reuse, completed save, reentrancy or scheduler contract.
scopes.s20: Existing source bindings/hooks. Services or full Execute bodies are not newly executed by this migration.
scopes.s21: Original copy/vector instructions with synthetic interface returns; result fields do not identify film recipe or save success.
scopes.s22: AFInfo consumer execution uses authentic saved blocks; ISO value conversion uses synthetic records. These are metadata contexts, not live AF or verified JPEG job ownership.
scopes.s23: Native record/register isolation and rectangle helper behavior; no multi-axis pixel semantics or native processing-time claim.
scopes.s24: Original GR III arithmetic/tables with model-service substitutions; native ceiling is not an optical sharpness guarantee.
scopes.s25: Native Snap values are verified; stock labels/backend actuation remain separate. WP11 permits new work only under its own target.
